VAG Scope guides

Practical guides to checking a used VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda and reading its control units with a phone and a Bluetooth OBD adapter.

  • How to check the mileage of a used VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda

    Compare the odometer with the distance the control units store, read the mileage logged with fault codes, and know what the result can and cannot prove.

  • Where to find the VIN on a VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda, and how to check it

    Where the VIN is marked on VW-group cars, how to read its 17 characters, and what it means when a control unit holds another car’s VIN.
